title: Your liver can regrow to full size after a large part is removed
body: The liver is the only internal organ able to regenerate substantial lost tissue. After surgeons remove part of a healthy liver, the remaining cells start dividing and the organ grows back to its original size, though not its original shape. This is what makes living-donor transplants possible: a donor gives away a section of their liver, and both the piece they keep and the piece the recipient receives grow back to near full size.
